title: SurrealDB write/read contention: in_flight=10>8 (p50=821.4ms, slow_queries=4154, qps=15.23). Likely a write-storm or hot
description: SurrealDB write/read contention: in_flight=10>8 (p50=821.4ms, slow_queries=4154, qps=15.23). Likely a write-storm or hot-row UPDATE pattern saturating the single-writer engine. Inspect by_op in /metrics/db; mitigations: batch hot-table writes, detach posterior/penalty writes from request hot paths, reduce failure-trace volume.
